titulo: Gender of nouns ending in -ez and -eza
subtitulo: La niñez, la vejez, la belleza, la pobreza: feminine.
regla: Nouns ending in -ez (abstract) and -eza are feminine: la niñez, la madurez, la belleza, la tristeza. Other -z nouns have no fixed rule.

bloques.texto: Nouns ending in **-ez** are almost always **feminine**, and they tend to be **abstract**: **la niñez**, **la madurez**, **la vejez**, **la escasez**, **la estupidez**, **la rapidez**.
Nouns ending in **-eza** are also **feminine**: **la belleza**, **la pobreza**, **la franqueza**, **la tristeza**, **la naturaleza**, **la cerveza**.
There are a couple of exceptions in **-ez** (**el pez**, **el ajedrez**).
Other nouns ending in just **-z** have no rule: **la luz**, **la voz**, **la paz** but **el lápiz**, **el arroz**, **el maíz**. Learn them one by one.
Plural of **-z**: change to **-ces**: **el pez** → **los peces**, **la voz** → **las voces**.
Tip: **-ez** and **-eza** are qualities, and qualities in Spanish wear a skirt: **la belleza**.

lista.es: ==La niñez== debería ser una época feliz para todos.
lista.en: Childhood should be a happy time for everyone.

lista.es: ==La vejez== de mi papá va a ser dura.
lista.en: My dad's old age is going to be hard.
We're worried about the water shortage.

lista.es: Lo que acabas de decir es ==una estupidez==.
lista.en: What you just said is nonsense.

lista.es: ==La franqueza== es una cualidad que admiro.
lista.en: Frankness is a quality I admire.

lista.es: ==La belleza== de Bahía de los Ángeles es impresionante.
lista.en: The beauty of Bahía de los Ángeles is stunning.
